assumptions: Savings use conservative typical bills: phone $120/mo, car insurance $2,000/yr, gear $200-300/yr. Your real number depends on your bill.

deals.discount: 10% off personal Unlimited lines; 25% off accessories online
steps: Open Verizon's first responder page and tap Check eligibility
Verify with ID.me (badge photo, pay stub or agency letter)
Discount shows on your bill in 1–2 cycles
deals.gotcha: Active, retired and volunteer responders qualify. Can't stack with military, nurse or teacher discounts. May re-verify.

deals.discount: 10–20% off unlimited lines, depending on plan
steps: Check eligibility on AT&T's FirstNet & Family page
One person on the account must be a verified FirstNet user
Credits start within about 3 bills
deals.gotcha: Needs a FirstNet-capable phone and SIM. Federal, career and volunteer responders qualify. Retirees use AT&T's separate retired-responder offer.

deals.discount: First Responder pricing on Magenta plans (about 6–10% per comparison sites)
steps: Log in to T-Mobile.com or T-Life
Profile → First Responder Verification
Upload an ID, recent pay stub or agency letter if asked
deals.gotcha: State and local only: federal agencies are not eligible. Verify within 45 days or the line can go up to $20/mo. Re-verify every year.

deals.discount: First responder pricing, Fios 300 from about $26/mo with AutoPay

savings.assumes: Depends on your area and current plan

steps: Open Verizon's first responder page
Verify with ID.me
Pick a Fios plan; the discount applies at the last step of the order
deals.gotcha: Only where Fios is available. A $99 setup fee may apply.

deals.discount: Federal employee discount and premium reductions

savings.assumes: GEICO doesn't publish the amount; it varies by state

steps: Call GEICO or open your policy online
Say: "I'm a federal employee. Please add the federal employee discount."
Ask them to re-quote with it applied
deals.gotcha: For federal employees, not state or local. Ask whether it stacks with your other discounts.

deals.discount: Up to 12% through IAFF and FOP partnerships
steps: Call Liberty Mutual or your agent
Ask for the first responder or FOP / IAFF member discount
Have your membership info ready
deals.gotcha: Tied to union or FOP membership. Amount from a comparison site, not Liberty Mutual's own page.

deals.discount: About 8% for members of approved occupation groups
steps: Call your Farmers agent
Ask whether your agency or job is an approved affinity group
Ask for a re-quote with the discount
deals.gotcha: Group lists vary by state. Amount from a comparison site.

deals.discount: Up to about 15% for first responders, depending on your club
steps: Call your regional AAA club
Ask for the first responder insurance discount
Ask whether it stacks with your member discount
deals.gotcha: Each AAA club sets its own discounts. Amount from a comparison site.

deals.discount: 50% off a new system (Protectors Program)
steps: Go to SimpliSafe.com/Protectors
Pick your status and tap Receive 50% Off
Verify with VerifyPass and use the one-time code at checkout
deals.gotcha: New system purchases only. Monitoring plan isn't discounted. Can't combine with other promos.

deals.discount: 20% off select Ring.com purchases
steps: Open Ring's first responder discount page
Verify your status
Buy on Ring.com with the discount applied
deals.gotcha: Ring's page doesn't say the subscription plan is covered. Can't combine with other Ring discounts.

deals.discount: 25% off for first responders, verified with ID.me
steps: Open Arlo's discounts page
Verify with ID.me
Ask support to apply it to an existing subscription if needed
deals.gotcha: Confirmed by Arlo staff on its forum, not its main page. Some users report trouble getting it on existing subscriptions.

deals.discount: $500 off select new Dodge, Jeep and Ram models

savings.assumes: Flat $500 when you buy or lease

steps: Open the Stellantis first responder page and tap Get Authorization Number
Verify through their third-party service
Give the number to any franchised dealer
deals.gotcha: Select models only. Federal LEOs and 911 dispatchers are named as eligible. Spouses only in some cases.

deals.discount: First Responder Discount on select vehicles, plus up to 20% off OnStar

savings.assumes: GM doesn't list the vehicle amount

steps: Confirm eligibility at gmfirstresponderdiscount.com
Get your authorization number
Bring it to the dealer; push the blue OnStar button for that discount
deals.gotcha: Select vehicles only. Check the amount with the dealer before you negotiate.

deals.discount: $500 Bonus Cash on eligible Ford vehicles
steps: Register at fordspecialoffer.com/firstresponders
Verify instantly through First Responder ID
Give the certificate number to the dealer
deals.gotcha: Active first responders only, not retirees. Source is a police association page, so confirm with the dealer.

deals.discount: Up to 30% off phones, TVs and appliances
steps: Open Samsung's first responder offer page
Create a Samsung Account and verify with ID.me (or a .gov email)
Shop signed in; discount shows at checkout
deals.gotcha: Limit of 2 products per category per year. Stacks with public sales.

deals.discount: 10% off annual or 24-month memberships
steps: Start a new prepaid annual or 24-month membership
Verify with ID.me at checkout
deals.gotcha: New members only. Not for monthly plans or renewals.

deals.discount: 10% off most items online and in the Nike App
steps: Sign in as a Nike Member
Verify with SheerID (name, agency, status)
Use the single-use code at checkout
deals.gotcha: Online only, first $500 of an order, one code every 7 days. Excludes SNKRS launches and gift cards.

deals.discount: About 20% off, with seasonal 40% events
steps: Open Under Armour's first responder page
Verify with ID.me
Discount applies at checkout
deals.gotcha: Amount changes by season. Reported by deal sites; couldn't open UA's own page to confirm.

deals.discount: Discounted in-store pricing on 38 duty-ready models

savings.assumes: Price shown at the dealer counter

steps: Find a FIRSTLINE dealer on Springfield's site
Bring agency photo ID (front and back)
Pay the FIRSTLINE price at the counter; no rebate forms
deals.gotcha: Federal, state and local officers, retired officers with credentials, firefighters and EMTs qualify. Certifications alone don't.

deals.discount: Special pricing on MLB, NBA and other event tickets

savings.assumes: Depends on the game and team

steps: Create a free GovX account
Verify your status
Search your team and buy through GovX
deals.gotcha: Only partner teams. Compare against the box office price before you buy.
